# Hippogriff — hippogriff.io

## About
Vicki Zhang is a senior full stack software engineer building agents at work and in spare time. Hippogriff.io is a site for things made on the journey of reimagining human & app interaction.

## Projects
- TypeCraft: A Space Invaders typing game that showcases how a small, well-crafted app can make a routine task more fun. https://typecraft.hippogriff.io
- Talent Promo: Resume writing agent that discovers your hidden strengths. https://talent-promo.hippogriff.io
- Remo: LiDAR-powered iOS room redesign agent — photograph a room, chat with an AI design consultant, get photorealistic redesigns and a shoppable product list. https://github.com/hippogriff-ai/remo

## Blog
Posts on software engineering, AI, agents, and building things. Feed: https://www.hippogriff.io/feed.xml

- Agent Memory Series: Letta Code's Git-Backed Memory Repo: How Letta Code memory works, traced with LangSmith. The model curates a git-backed memory folder; worktrees isolate the dream agent, merges reconcile divergence, and commit history carries provenance. Plus what replaces git (CAS and a relational store) when the agent has no shell. https://www.hippogriff.io/blog/letta-code-deepdive
- Agent Memory Series: Graphiti - A graph that tells time: How Graphiti works — bi-temporal fact edges carrying a world clock and a system clock, an engineered update policy that settles contradictions by world dates and invalidates instead of overwriting, and the gaps that remain for enterprise use. https://www.hippogriff.io/blog/graphiti-deepdive
- Agent Memory Series: Mem0 Deepdive: How Mem0 v3 works — LLM-extracted flat, add-only facts, semantic search boosted by BM25 keyword and entity matching, and the open questions it leaves for enterprise use. https://www.hippogriff.io/blog/mem0-deepdive
- Reading Anthropic's Memory API: Best-guess design analysis of the Memory API — per-file linearizability via compare-and-swap, file-based memory as a distributed primitive. https://www.hippogriff.io/blog/reading-anthropics-memory-api
- How Agents Communicate Inside A Team: How Claude Code agent teams route messages — the communication boundary is prompt instruction, rebuilt from scratch in ~320 lines of Python with the Claude Agent SDK. https://www.hippogriff.io/blog/how-agents-communicate-inside-a-team
- Remo: From Moldy Bathroom to Shoppable Redesign, All AI-Orchestrated: Building an iOS LiDAR room-redesign agent at the Claude Code x Cerebral Valley hackathon. https://www.hippogriff.io/blog/remo-lidar-room-redesign-agent
- What I learned from building a resume agent: Agent design lessons from building Talent Promo. https://www.hippogriff.io/blog/what-i-learned-from-resume-agent
- Why I built TypeCraft: Daily grind becomes daily play. https://www.hippogriff.io/blog/why-i-built-typecraft
